thread:
emily_peopleops: Quick heads-up: offer ready for UK candidate Anita Patel. Offer ID: 100112. Comp band S4. Candidate asking for medical active day-1 and a one-time sign-on bonus (GBP 5,000) paid in first payroll. Start date proposed 2026-05-03. Need approvals for bonus + benefits exception.

ryan_recruiter: Anita accepted verbally yesterday. Salary matches band, no relocation. Signed offer uploaded to HR drive: /drive/offers/100112.pdf.

priya_mgr: Manager approves sign-on as recruitment incentive. Can confirm role headcount and budget.

claire_benefits: Day-1 medical in UK can be supported but we need to confirm enrollment code (UK-MED-STD) and whether voluntary benefits require waiting period. For core medical it's ok.

nate_finance: FYI a sign-on paid on first payroll impacts cashflow and requires AP code S-ONE-TIME. Finance needs payroll cutoff date for first run and tax withholding guidance. Also confirm if bonus is gross or net.

legal_ops: For UK, sign-on is taxable as employment income. We need candidate acknowledgment and bonus clause in offer addendum. Also confirm bonus clawback term if they leave within 6 months.

emily_peopleops: Proposed routing: 1) Benefits confirm UK-MED-STD day-1 2) Legal approves addendum + clawback clause 3) Finance signs payroll code and tax handling 4) Manager signoff (done) 5) Ops Exec final sign-off for exception. I'll kick off the automated routing.

ops-bot: Created exception workflow: /exceptions start offer-100112 type=signon+benefits. Status: benefits_pending, legal_pending, finance_pending, exec_pending.

claire_benefits: Confirmed: UK-MED-STD can be activated 2026-05-03. No voluntary benefits until month end but core cover OK.

legal_ops: Drafted addendum with 6-month clawback. Candidate signed the addendum via DocuSign. Attached link.

nate_finance: Confirm payroll: use AP code S-ONE-TIME, tax grossed per PAYE. Payroll cutoff for May first-pay run is 2026-05-01; if hire on 05-03 bonus will hit next run (May) but we can request exception to include in first run if payroll runs ad-hoc. Approving with memo: payroll_note_100112.

emily_peopleops: OK routing to execs: /route-for-approval --offer 100112 --exception signon+med_day1 --approvers priya_mgr,vp-people.

ops-bot: Approval requested from: priya_mgr (approved), vp-people (pending).

vp-people: Approved. Please ensure payroll memo on file.

ops-bot: Offer 100112 fully approved. Actions created: onboarding invite scheduled 2026-04-28, payroll ticket PT-7721 to include sign-on in May run, benefits enrollment set to 2026-05-03.

emily_peopleops: Thanks everyone. Logging exception in hire packet and tagging for retrospective on sign-on trends. Closing thread.
